Package com.societegenerale.failover.configuration

Class JdbcHeartbeatPushClient

java.lang.Object
com.societegenerale.failover.configuration.JdbcHeartbeatPushClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
HeartbeatPushClient
public class JdbcHeartbeatPushClient extends Object implements HeartbeatPushClient
HeartbeatPushClient that writes straight into the dashboard's FAILOVER_DASHBOARD_HEARTBEAT table instead of POSTing to the ingest endpoint — the JDBC-direct counterpart to JdbcSnapshotPushClient, active alongside it when both failover.dashboard.cluster.snapshot.jdbc.enabled=true and failover.dashboard.cluster.snapshot.heartbeat.enabled=true are set. Same table, same upsert logic as the dashboard's own HeartbeatStoreJdbc — the two writers are interchangeable from the table's point of view.

Fails soft, matching HeartbeatStoreJdbc: heartbeat is a supplementary liveness signal, not the metrics path, so a DataAccessException (e.g. the table doesn't exist yet) is caught by the caller (HeartbeatPublisher) and logged once rather than propagated.

Author:
Anand Manissery
